title: An Evaluation of X-Ray Irradiation Induced Dynamic Refresh Characterization in DRAM

abstract: In order to identify the change of dynamic refresh in dynamic random access memory (DRAM) affected by X-ray irradiation, we investigated the refresh of the weakest bit with regard to various X-ray exposure condition. Thermal annealing was implemented to trace the recovery behavior of weak bits on damage induced by X-ray irradiation. In addition, the recovery of dynamic refresh at room temperature was expected empirically and compared with the storage test at room temperature.
